recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a single-file mobile portrait browser game titled **Legend of the Verdant Sigil** from this prompt: Zelda RPG adventure. A Zelda RPG adventure game with mythic overworld exploration, puzzle dungeons, item-gated progression, hidden secrets, heroic questing, environmental puzzle-solving, boss encounters, and a legendary fantasy tone with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The mechanic truth is a top-down canvas survival quest: touch/drag moves a green-clad hero, an orbiting moonblade attacks automatically, monsters spawn from edges, relic pickups upgrade stats, rupee score increases on monster defeat, shrine level increases every 10 kills, a Gloom Temple Warden boss appears after 30 kills, hero death loses, boss defeat wins, and restart returns to the same loop.

Use procedural CSS/canvas visuals for a verdant overworld shrine, runic dungeon grid, golden sigil UI, hearts, relic particles, readable portrait controls, and legendary fantasy tone.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The source is a single-file browser canvas action-survival game. The player moves freely by mouse/touch drag, an orbiting sword automatically damages enemies, enemy waves spawn from screen edges, loot upgrades attack/defense/speed/health, score increases from kills, level increases every 10 kills, a boss appears after 30 kills, hero death triggers game over, and boss defeat triggers victory.

## Protected mechanics
Input semantics, movement speed model, spawn cadence, collision radii, damage/health semantics, loot effects, scoring, level increments, boss threshold, failure, victory, restart, and debug hooks are protected.

## Transformable surfaces
Title, copy, HUD labels, entity names, palette, procedural background, canvas drawing style, particles, audio framing, start/victory/failure language, and mobile visual hierarchy are safe to transform.

## Rebuilt target
Legend of the Verdant Sigil: a portrait-first mythic Zelda-like grove quest where a green-clad hero survives a shrine trial, gathers relic upgrades, opens a sealed dungeon, and defeats the Gloom Temple Warden.
